decision_context.title: Executive cohort decision
decision_context.context: Quarterly retention review before the next intervention window.
decision_context.task: Decide whether the South cohort needs a targeted retention action.
decision_context.decision: Direct the intervention using cohort evidence; aggregate revenue is context.
decision_context.current_truth: North and West are on plan; South is below the retention target.
decision_context.tone: Decisive and evidence led, with aggregate growth as context.
decision_context.misunderstanding: A reader could mistake total growth for evidence that every cohort is healthy.

decision_context.title: Conditional experiment readout
decision_context.person: Product experimentation lead and quality owner
decision_context.context: Four week randomized onboarding test with a quality guardrail.
decision_context.task: Choose whether to expand treatment beyond a limited rollout.
decision_context.decision: Continue only as a limited rollout while the quality and retention caveats remain open.
decision_context.current_truth: Treatment conversion is higher in the observed sample; long term retention is unknown.
decision_context.tone: Measured and conditional; sample limits stay adjacent to the treatment evidence.
decision_context.misunderstanding: The trend may be read as proof of durable lift without its sample caveat.

decision_context.title: Causal yield investigation
decision_context.person: Process engineer, equipment owner, and lot disposition lead
decision_context.context: Affected lot compared with spatial and paired reference evidence.
decision_context.task: Determine the containment needed before lot release.
decision_context.decision: Contain the affected lot until chamber verification agrees with the paired reference run.
decision_context.current_truth: The local yield loss aligns with chamber drift; causal certainty remains under verification.
decision_context.tone: Investigative, traceable, and explicit about what is verified.
decision_context.misunderstanding: A shared headline weight could imply the mechanism is already proven.

decision_context.title: Dense operating review
decision_context.person: Shift operations lead and reliability engineering
decision_context.context: Line 4 shift, control chart, evidence table, and open release actions.
decision_context.task: Review operating evidence together and decide whether capacity can be released.
decision_context.decision: Keep the recipe locked until the paired-lot check closes both open items.
decision_context.current_truth: The overnight trend recovered; the next paired-lot result is still pending.
decision_context.tone: Compact, technical, and scannable without hiding supporting evidence.
decision_context.misunderstanding: Large gaps may separate the decision from the operating evidence that qualifies it.

decision_context.title: Fresh mixed evidence holdout
decision_context.person: Regional cold-chain planner and depot operations
decision_context.context: Fresh synthetic delivery-capacity review with trend, allocation, comparison, and lead-time evidence.
decision_context.task: Allocate reserve capacity across three depots while one supplier date remains unconfirmed.
decision_context.decision: Reserve qualified stock for the constrained route and keep the uncertain supplier allocation provisional.
decision_context.current_truth: Demand exceeds the confirmed buffer in two weeks; one lead-time estimate is not yet committed.
decision_context.tone: Operational and constraint led, with comparison and next action kept together.
decision_context.misunderstanding: A point estimate could be mistaken for committed capacity while one date is provisional.

decision_context.title: Fresh sparse release decision
decision_context.context: A small evidence packet for a batch release with one unresolved validation result.
decision_context.task: Decide whether to release the batch or hold it for one more sample.
decision_context.decision: Hold the batch until the missing validation sample is reviewed.
decision_context.current_truth: Two checks pass; the third result is unavailable, so the evidence is incomplete.
decision_context.tone: Direct and open, with uncertainty visible before the next step.
decision_context.misunderstanding: The two passing checks could obscure the missing validation result.
